title: Manchester United Hit Bournemouth For Four In Pre-Season Exhibition | Football News - News18
text:
Premier League side Manchester United registered a resounding victory over fellow English side Bournemouth at the Soldier Field in the Premier League Summer Series. Rasmus Hojlund, Patrick Dorgu, Amad Diallo and Ethan Williams all netted for United as Ruben Amorim’s men coasted to a 4-1 win over the Cherries. Bournemouth got a consolation as Matthijs de Ligt turned the ball into his own net towards the end of the game.

Hojlund opened the scoring in the 8th minute with a header past Bournemouth goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic, thanks to a superb cross from Danish compatriot Dorgu. Dorgu then doubled United’s lead in the 25th minute, capitalising on a quick lofted free-kick from Mason Mount, muscling his way into the area and sliding a cool finish beneath the advancing Petrovic.
Diallo added United’s third goal in the 53rd minute before Amorim made nine changes with 20 minutes remaining. Substitute Williams took just two minutes to make his mark, curling a low finish into the bottom corner to extend United’s lead to 4-0.
advetisement The only blemish on United’s performance was an own goal from Matthijs de Ligt in the 88th minute.
In Wednesday’s other Premier League friendly in Chicago, West Ham came from behind to defeat former manager David Moyes’s Everton 2-1. Idrissa Gueye put Everton ahead after 17 minutes, but West Ham equalised through Brazilian international Lucas Paqueta just before half-time. Germany international Niclas Fullkrug’s 64th-minute strike secured the Hammers’ victory.
This result marked another disappointing pre-season setback for Everton, who were beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth on Saturday.
“I’m not overly concerned because I don’t have the players which I need and what I want," Everton boss Moyes said afterward. “We knew before we came to the US we were going to be really up against it. So, it was never going to be us coming here and winning."
